episodes.title: Hit & Run
episodes.summary: As his American wife departs for a dance audition in New York, Israeli tour guide Segev finds his world thrown into chaos by a sudden tragedy.

episodes.title: Love & Loss
episodes.summary: Segev begins to question the nature of the accident as more clues emerge to Danielle's mystery caller and the car's driver.

episodes.title: Friends & Foes
episodes.summary: In New York, two old friends from the Mexico days help Segev track down the elusive Isaac. The Wexlers host a memorial service at their home.

episodes.title: Breaking & Entering
episodes.summary: A visit to the New York dance company sends Segev on a desperate search for clues to his wife's past. In Israel, Assaf is interrogated by his captors.

episodes.title: Flesh & Blood
episodes.summary: Tali identifies the man from Segev's wedding video, the police close in on Ron, and Naomi seeks intel from a New York Times reporter.

episodes.title: Hide & Seek
episodes.summary: Segev spots a familiar face at JFK and sets out in pursuit. Meanwhile, Tali gets in trouble at work, and Naomi brokers a meeting with the CIA.

episodes.title: Part & Parcel
episodes.summary: While reeling from another painful blow, Segev stumbles on secret messages from his wife. Tali learns the truth about why Danielle was targeted.

episodes.title: Prose & Cons
episodes.summary: Naomi races to get her story to press in time to save Segev. Tali asks Assaf for help with the Omer situation. Detective Newkirk has an epiphany.

episodes.title: Search & Destroy
episodes.summary: As Naomi decodes the message in the notebook, Tali urges Shira to leave the country. Segev finds himself caught between two powerful forces.
